result.png.shows: Deformed cantilever mesh (displacements from the real good-fine job.frd, x20) coloured by nodal von Mises from the same .frd, allowable stress 166.7 MPa marked on the colour bar (spec_limits gate); tip deflection + wall stress vs mesh size with the +-2% band (convergence gate); reference-beam FEA/Euler-Bernoulli ratios with the +-3% band (verification gate).

loop.png.shows: Agent-loop replay (bad -> partly fixed -> good, gates failing per iteration, a replay of real grade JSONs) plus the 10-artifact x 3-gate self-test matrix; each red cell shows the measured value vs the limit from that mutant's real verdict JSON; script-enforced no-overlap check.

demo.mp4.shows: Animated cut: the real good-fine .frd field orbited in 3-D (hero at full load; linear-static ramp 0 -> 1000 N; dive onto the clamped wall), this run's own console replay at the measured Nx over still-playing footage, the overload-10x mutant's own field under 10x load, then the PASS badge + gate rows as a HUD over the still-moving field; 2.5 s static end card. All overlay numbers are injected from this run's verdict/selftest/timing files.
demo.mp4.command: bash media/make_media.sh (clips: render_clips.py; composition: gen_composition.py -> video/index.html; render: npx hyperframes render (pinned 0.8.99); encode: ffmpeg -crf 18 -maxrate 1900k -bufsize 3800k +faststart (VBV cap sized to the <= 8 MiB budget); master: media/master/demo_hf.mp4)
